Bombonera.metaDescription: Explore an interactive, unofficial reimagining of La Bombonera: the surroundings, entrance, tunnel, pitch and stands.
Bombonera.title: The stadium that beats, from the inside.
Bombonera.description: Explore the surroundings, enter through the gates and discover the stadium from six viewpoints. Follow the guided route or take control of the camera.
Bombonera.unofficial: Unofficial artistic reimagining · Not affiliated with the club
Bombonera.sourcesDescription: The experience adapts A1905's 3D model under CC BY 4.0 and calibrates its scale and surroundings with the 2025 UPV survey, OpenStreetMap, and 2025–2026 visual and construction records. It is an indicative representation, not a club-authorized as-built survey.
